name: What is the process for planning a home addition with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning a home addition with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, needs, and the specific challenges your household faces regarding space. Following this, we develop a comprehensive design scope and layout planning, utilizing CAD-supported layouts to visualize the proposed addition. We then manage all aspects of permit coordination, construction, structural integration, and interior and exterior finishing. This integrated approach ensures clear communication and a streamlined experience from your initial idea to the final completion of your new space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Planning a home addition with us involves an initial consultation, comprehensive design and layout planning, and full management of permit coordination, construction, and finishing.
